items.title: Remove unused MCP dependency from root package metadata
items.context: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk is declared in the root package but no current source imports it; cleanup should update package-lock without touching unrelated dependencies.

items.title: Make implementation review protocol internally consistent
items.context: packages/main/src/handlers/implementation-review.ts defines implementation_review_result_set/get, but the handler is not registered and no command schema exposes it. Either wire it as a supported command or remove the dead protocol; prefer wiring because store/lifecycle docs already reference implementation-review.json.

items.title: Resolve obsolete intent coverage module status
items.context: packages/main/src/core/intent-coverage.ts is not consumed by runtime and reflects legacy testIntent fixture coverage. Decide whether to remove it or move it to legacy test-only support without weakening current verificationIntent/verificationEvidence coverage.

items.title: Archive or remove one-time migration scripts that are no longer product commands
items.context: scripts/convert-fixtures.cjs, migrate-annotations.cjs, migrate-fixture-reform*.mjs, remove-file-level-test.cjs and similar one-off scripts should not remain as active product code unless still referenced by npm scripts/docs/tests.

items.title: Remove package-local legacy active story metadata from product tree
items.context: packages/main/docs/story/actives contains old B-e5f1/B-f61f/B-5c84 style metadata under an obsolete active story path. Current story metadata lives under .lattice/story/actives; preserve any needed fixture semantics elsewhere or remove the stale residue.
